title: AI-Powered Dental CAD Solution for Fully Automated Digital Prosthesis Design
summary: Imagoworks reports that Dentbird generates patient-specific dental designs in minutes, automating labor-intensive CAD work during real-world pilots.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Dentbird uses deep learning and 3D dental data to detect margins and generate prosthesis designs. Imagoworks describes real-world pilots and automated design in minutes, claiming lower technician workload and shorter treatment workflows. The account provides no standardized before-and-after timing comparison or patient health outcomes.
purpose: Automate dental prosthesis design and reduce manual CAD work.

ratings.reason: Imagoworks reports automated prosthesis designs in minutes and reduced manual workload during pilots. A standardized timing comparison is unavailable.
Shorter treatment and improved oral health are claimed without a measured patient outcome.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.
